title: When the Rivergate Falls
premise: Sable Sterling's salvage crew is scraping by on navy-denied wreck dives in the Rivergate Delta when Mara Vance, the rival who once cost him his old team, arrives with a contract: recover a sunken ledger from the flooded town of Ash Hollow, upstream where the crew's drowned past is buried. The ledger holds proof that the dam collapse years ago was no accident, and the navy's gunboats will do anything to keep it buried. As the monsoon closes in, Sable must choose between loyalty to the crew he's built and the truth about the night his brother died. In the end, he releases the ledger to the river towns instead of selling it, the crew survives the flood together, and Sable finally stops running from the name he left at Ash Hollow.
about_author: Lena Sandoval is a former river pilot turned adventure writer who grew up in a family of salvage divers on the Delta coast. Her novels draw on years spent running cargo through monsoon country, where she learned that every wreck keeps a secret and every crew keeps a promise.

chapters.title: The Wreck Nobody Names
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. The crew dives a navy-restricted wreck in the Delta, nearly losing deckhand Juno to a collapsed hold, and Sable realizes the navy is watching them too closely. When Mara Vance docks beside them offering the Ash Hollow job, the crew's old wounds surface. The beat is uneasy tension: the quiet life Sable built is already cracking, and the past is offering a price.

chapters.title: Upstream of Every Promise
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The crew runs the river at night, evading navy patrols, and old loyalties fray as Mara reveals the ledger could clear her father's name, or hang them all. Sable and Mara trade accusations about the night of the collapse, and Juno quietly sides with Sable. The beat is grudging alliance: enemies forced to trust, each hiding what they know about Ash Hollow.

chapters.title: What the Water Kept
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. In the flooded ruins of Ash Hollow, Sable dives the collapsed dam intake and finds the ledger, and his brother's final dive tag beside it. Navy gunboats corner the crew in the gorge as the monsoon's first wall of rain hits, forcing a desperate run through rising water. The beat is devastating revelation and climax: Sable learns his brother died trying to expose the truth, and chooses, under fire, to take the ledger to the towns rather than sell it or sink it.

chapters.title: The River Remembers Its Own
chapters.summary: Juno's POV. The crew rides out the flood in an abandoned lockhouse, distributing copies of the ledger to river towns before the navy can burn them. Mara leaves without forgiveness but with the truth, and the crew, battered but intact, chooses to stay together rather than scatter. The beat is hard-won belonging: Sable speaks his brother's name aloud for the first time, and the found family holds.
